title: Learning from risk: LLM-guided generation of safety-critical scenarios with prior knowledge

control_signal.value: Structured scene description (trajectories, map context, relations) given to an LLM, plus target risk regime (low, high, long-tail) defined by TTC, TLC and THW thresholds.

control_mechanism.value: LLM with chain-of-thought parses the scene and outputs adaptive loss weights (e.g. adversarial crash, TTC) that drive optimization over the CVAE latent space; latent sampling and loss weights are modulated to span risk levels.

base_model.value: Graph-based CVAE (CVAE-GNN): encoder, decoder and map-conditioned prior network, producing joint future trajectories; loss with reconstruction, KL and collision terms.

datasets.value: highD and nuScenes for training; evaluation in CARLA and SMARTS simulators.

metrics.value: Trajectory realism score, interaction consistency score, Long-Tail Coverage Rate, sim-to-real discrepancy; collision rate, TTC, TLC, THW, inter-vehicle distance.

controllability_evidence.value: LLM-enhanced scenarios lower average TTC from 0.89 s to 0.34 s and distance from 3.03 m to 0.30 m; long-tail coverage rises by more than 30-40% over CVAE or random perturbation baselines.

notes: Table 6 labels the baseline 'relatively safe' yet lists 96.2% collision rate versus 97.1%, which looks inconsistent. Conclusion truncated in packet, so limitations may exist.
